purpose: Teach: ケチ/熱気/喋る/注ぐ/末尾/相棒/やわらかい/おやすみなさい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスのみんな、自販機ケチる派、いるよね。
lines.en: There are people in class who get all weird about spending money at vending machines.
lines.style: Light, observant tone. Slight smirk underneath. Testing to see if he gets the joke. Quick delivery, no drag.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。スタジアムの熱気、忘れられないな。
lines.en: Yeah, that feeling in the stadium — I can't shake it.
lines.style: Softer than expected. Almost to himself. Genuine warmth breaking through the cool exterior. Slight pause before 'can't shake it' — he's remembering.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨夜、長電話で、喋るのが止まらなかった。
lines.en: Last night we were on the phone forever and I just couldn't stop talking.
lines.style: Lighter, almost embarrassed happiness. The words tumble out a bit. She's not hiding how much it meant. Warm, unguarded.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コップに水を注ぐ、結構難しいよ。
lines.en: Pouring water into a cup is actually way harder than you'd think.
lines.style: Dry, understated observation. Deadpan delivery like he's making an absurd argument. Just a hint of smile in the voice — testing if she'll laugh at the randomness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 宿題の末尾、自分の意見、書きました。
lines.en: I wrote my own opinion at the end of the homework assignment.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Not bragging — careful, sincere. She's showing him she thought it mattered to put herself in it. Steady pace, clear.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: クラスメイト、相棒っていう感じ、最近、特に。
lines.en: Lately I'm feeling like my classmates and I are becoming real partners, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. He's working through something as he speaks. Genuine warmth but also vulnerability — he's admitting he's closer to people now. Soft eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 寝具がやわらかい、よく眠れた。
lines.en: My bedding is so soft — I slept really well.
lines.style: Drowsy, contented exhale. The voice of someone who's already halfway to sleep. Gentle, no urgency. A simple happiness in small comfort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ、また明日。おやすみなさい。
lines.en: See you tomorrow then. Good night.
lines.style: Quiet affection in the closing. Not rushed. The care of someone who's comfortable enough to leave without fanfare. Steady, warm, real.
